scope: Lightweight educational selection;no optional content authorship

records.rationale: Compact event-state modelling teaches how repeated overtaking forces a new lap;good practice after basic simulations.
A useful bridge from quadratic DP to scheduled updates and range maxima;subtasks expose why simple greedy is insufficient.
Good exchange-argument and batched matching practice;more specialized than basic greedy scheduling.
Builds confidence in constructive existence arguments and incremental arrangements without advanced data structures.
Connects adjacent-swap movement costs to selecting a fixed-size subset,then choosing a useful DP dimension.
Useful practice in maintaining a repeatedly modified sorted multiset and comparing simulation costs across subtasks.
An excellent reduction from adjacent swaps/removals to counting crossing pairs with an active-position Fenwick tree.
Turns physical meeting times into interval inequalities and emphasizes strict boundaries without floating-point arithmetic.
Accessible circular construction practice using order constraints and extreme elements;good transition from checking to building.
Teaches event-driven accounting:accumulate elapsed time only when a local condition changes instead of simulating every resident daily.
Useful counting and integer-division feasibility practice with many queries;best after simpler frequency-distribution problems.
Offers advanced move-set classification and parity/distance reasoning,but extensive chess-specific cases make it enrichment rather than core practice.
Develops connectivity equivalence and information-gathering strategies with persistent hypothetical graph designs;useful interactive enrichment.
Bulk ownership transfers and duration aggregation teach why per-item simulation can be too expensive;suited to advanced merging practice.
Creative query construction and learning from blocked robot motion provide strong enrichment,but scored query minimization is specialized.
Teaches adversarial-response construction and equal-sum invariants under a small query budget;useful after simpler interactive tasks.

source_access: Official statistics task pages and linked PDFs accessible via web tool. Data Centers solution ZIP is unsupported by the web tool;not retried,not read,and not claimed audited. Task PDF suffices for lightweight selection.
